correctness.rationale: For q=p^r with p>3, rational smooth points normalize uniquely by x+y+z=1, with xyz nonzero and excluding (1/3,1/3,1/3), giving (q-1)(q-2). The Gauss/tangent map is Gamma=[1/x-3:1/y-3:1/z-3]. Tangent coincidences parametrized by d_v(t)=t+3(1-t)v factor exact contact equation -t(t-1)(At+B). Simultaneous poles when coordinates repeat are removed. Other rational contact exists exactly when distinct x,y,z and AB(A+B)≠0. Centered coordinates u=3x-1 etc decompose singleton set into six disjoint lines (6(q-3)), split conic e(q-4) with e=0/2 according q mod 3, and rational cubic q-5-e, leading S=7q-23+e(q-5), N2=((q-1)(q-2)-S)/2. Exact algebraic symbolic factor and finite-field tangent fibers over eleven primes q=5..41 independently verified. Universal field result follows from algebra, not enumeration.
